title: Visitor
transcript:
A woman on the other side of the glass. Sixty, perhaps. Her good cotton sari.
She doesn't say who she is. She talks about the rain, the bus fare, the neighbour's buffalo.

VISITOR:
"They drained the old tank this year. Behind the temple. Nothing in it now. Only mud."

She takes a photograph from her purse and presses it flat to the glass.
Two boys on stone steps, squinting at the camera. Wet hair. One holds up eight fingers.

VISITOR:
"Keep it, beta. I have another."

She slides it through the gap under the glass. On the back, in her careful hand:
Parth & Raman Varma.
